tools.name: comms5_confirm_and_promote_seed
tools.title: Confirm Steward-approved draft
tools.description:
Record Pat's approval and atomically materialize one exact draft objective.

    This governed write verifies transport-attested Steward authority, explicit
    confirmation, the eligible specification ID/version/hash, and idempotency,
    then records bounded authority and creates the canonical objective record.
    It does not execute Codex or other work, run shell commands, cancel or
    supersede work, grant arbitrary authority, or bypass Grace, Relay,
    capability, or reconciliation gates. Client identity is provenance only.

content.description: Complete replacement content for the exact current draft revision.
content.title: ProposalContent

tools.name: reasoning_exchange_list_requests
tools.description: List bounded durable advisory requests routed to a provider for authenticated Steward review. Returns the exact request/correlation and immutable review subject when present.

tools.name: reasoning_exchange_claim_request
tools.description: Claim one exact routed advisory request with a finite lease and fencing identity. The claim is recorded as authenticated Steward activity.

tools.name: reasoning_exchange_submit_response
tools.description: Submit one bounded advisory against the active correlated Steward claim and exact immutable review digest. Advice grants no proposal approval or execution authority.

tools.name: reasoning_exchange_status
tools.description: Read state, sanitized diagnostics, provenance and digests for one exact correlated exchange. Response contents are never returned.

tools.name: comms5_authorize_grace_experiment
tools.title: Authorize bounded Grace autonomy experiment
tools.description: Activate one exact, 24-hour Grace/Luna experiment authorization through the existing Steward authority registry. This single approval covers at most five reasoning recoveries and two Luna requests, with a $5 total ceiling including $0.04104010 prior spend. It does not authorize unrelated objectives or unrestricted Engineering execution.

objective_id.description: Exact approved Grace autonomy objective; other objectives are rejected.
objective_id.title: Objective Id

explicit_steward_confirmation.description: Approve the complete 24-hour, $5 total experiment envelope with up to five recoveries and two Luna requests.
explicit_steward_confirmation.title: Explicit Steward Confirmation

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this one standing authorization operation.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

tools.name: comms5_amend_grace_experiment
tools.title: Amend bounded Grace autonomy experiment
tools.description: One authenticated, audited amendment of the existing r2 experiment from two to four total Luna requests. The two new slots are restricted to one CME diagnostic recovery request and one performance evaluation request. Preserves consumed requests, recovery count, original $5 ceiling, objective scope, and exact expiration. Does not create a grant or reset counters.

authorization_id.description: Exact active authorization ID to amend.

new_max_luna_requests.description: Amended total ceiling, 4; previously used requests remain counted.

expires_at.description: Exact original authorization expiry; this amendment does not extend it.

explicit_steward_confirmation.description: Approve this exact amendment through authenticated Steward transport.

tools.name: comms5_authorize_grace_supervision
tools.title: Authorize continuous Grace Luna supervision
tools.description: Authenticated Steward approval for exactly CME stall diagnostics/recovery guidance and Grace performance evaluation/feedback using the existing Luna exchange. New $5 operational budget, no fixed lifetime request count, $0.05 maximum reserved cost per request. Does not alter or transfer the r2 experiment grant. Omit expires_at for no time expiry, or provide an ISO-8601 expiry.

total_budget_usd.description: Fixed new operational ceiling; prior experiment spending is not transferred.

per_request_limit_usd.description: Maximum reserved cost per Luna request.

expires_at.description: Optional explicit ISO-8601 expiry. Omit for no time expiry.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this approval; changed scope conflicts.

tools.name: comms5_grace_supervision_status
tools.title: Inspect Grace supervisory Luna authorization
tools.description: Return status, exact scope, actual spending, outstanding reservations, remaining budget, and request activity. Steward-authenticated read.

tools.name: comms5_revoke_grace_supervision
tools.title: Revoke Grace supervisory Luna authorization
tools.description: Revoke the exact standing authorization and linked resident:grace Luna grant through the existing AuthorityRegistry. Requires authenticated Steward confirmation. Spending history is retained.

authorization_id.description: Exact standing authorization ID returned by the approval operation.

explicit_steward_confirmation.description: Confirm revocation of this exact authorization.

tools.name: comms5_request_delegation_grant
tools.title: Request a reusable delegation grant
tools.description: Create a pending scoped grant with an optional fixed count and typed duration. Approval/rejection remains on the separate authenticated Steward control path.

principal_id.description: Target grantee principal, not the authenticated caller.

max_uses.description: Positive value is a total successful-use limit; null is unlimited.

duration_spec.description: Typed activation duration; indefinite is explicit and max_uses remains independent.

request_ref.description: Bounded reason or source reference; it is not approval.

tools.name: comms5_get_delegation_grant_status
tools.title: Get delegation grant status
tools.description: Read a bounded status record by request_id or grant_id. Exactly one identifier is required; visibility is enforced by the authenticated delegation service.

tools.name: comms5_revoke_delegation_grant
tools.title: Surrender your delegated grant
tools.description: Surrender only the authenticated caller's exact active delegated grant. No principal identity is accepted in the arguments; the backend derives and verifies the grantee from authenticated context.

tools.name: comms5_request_delegation_grant_change
tools.title: Request a delegation grant change
tools.description: Request an audited extension, permission upgrade, or combined change. This creates a pending successor only; separate Steward approval is required.

max_uses.description: Positive value is a total successful-use limit; null is unlimited.

duration_spec.description: Typed activation duration; indefinite is explicit and max_uses remains independent.

change_kind.description: Choose extension, permission upgrade, or one combined request.

request_ref.description: Bounded change reason; it is not approval.
